facts.fact: 母亲只在做饭时哼歌；这天她在切胡萝卜做汤，Beatrice 把最后几颗洋葱滑下砧板丢进锅里。
facts.anchor: She only ever hums when she cooks.

facts.fact: 议会领袖 Marcus Eaton 每周来家里吃一次晚饭，从他儿子离开 Abnegation 起，已持续两年。
facts.anchor: Marcus has been coming over for dinner once a week since his son left us—so, for two years.

facts.fact: Marcus 的妻子 Evelyn Eaton 死于第二次怀孕的并发症；她的儿子数年后在选择仪式上离开 Abnegation，此后 Marcus 独居。
facts.anchor: Evelyn Eaton died from complications with her second pregnancy.

facts.fact: Abnegation 的孩子在饭桌上不许说话；Beatrice 分心搅汤，直到察觉 Susan 在看她才开始吃。
facts.anchor: Children aren’t allowed to talk at the dinner table in Abnegation

facts.fact: Beatrice 陪母亲服务无派系者，却厌恶每一秒；有人当面叫她 Stiff，她不还口。
facts.anchor: But I hate every second of it.

facts.fact: 议会领袖叫 Marcus Eaton，长相与父亲相仿（高个、短棕发、灰衣），但脸上什么都读不出来。
facts.anchor: The council leader’s name is Marcus Eaton.

facts.fact: 新闻简报称 Dauntless 城墙守卫出现记忆缺失、且事前都去过记忆库；Marcus 是全市唯一能完全进入记忆库系统的人，他把指控斥为 nonsense，反指 Erudite 领袖 Jeanine Matthews。
facts.anchor: notably the only person in the city with full access to the Memory Vault’s systems

facts.fact: 母亲没有提高声音，只判她「沉默之刑至明早」；违反者至少被关在 Abnegation 总部一天。
夜里她穿上靴子爬消防梯上屋顶，离地至少十层，最后对着城市放声大喊，惊起一群黑鸟。
facts.anchor: I’m at least ten stories off the ground now
